G'''hostly troll bruisers''' are [[monster]]s found inside of the [[City of Um troll cave]], entry from the [[Large cave opening (City of Um)|large cave opening]] on the south coast of the [[City of Um]]. There are seven of them residing within the cave alongside with seven [[ghostly troll thrower]]s and various other ghostly troll characters.
